task_spec.problem_statement: Read two integers a and b from standard input and print their sum.
task_spec.constraints: Integers may be negative or zero.

cases.correct:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a + b)
cases.broken:
a, b = map(int, input().split())
print(a - b)
cases.defect_explanation: Subtracts the second integer instead of adding it.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonempty line of space-separated integers and print the largest value.
task_spec.constraints: The list may contain only negative integers.

cases.defect_explanation: Initializing the maximum to zero fails on all-negative input.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonempty line of integers and print how many are even.
task_spec.constraints: Zero and negative even numbers must be counted.

cases.correct:
values = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(sum(value % 2 == 0 for value in values))
cases.broken:
values = list(map(int, input().split()))
print(sum(value % 2 == 1 for value in values))
cases.defect_explanation: Counts odd values instead of even values.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read an integer n and print the sum of all integers from 1 through n, inclusive. For n = 0, print 0.

cases.defect_explanation: The range excludes n, so positive inputs lose the last term.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonempty string on one line. Print YES if it reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise print NO. Comparisons are case-sensitive.

cases.correct:
text = input()
print('YES' if text == text[::-1] else 'NO')
cases.broken:
text = input()
print('YES' if text[0] == text[-1] else 'NO')
cases.defect_explanation: Checks the end characters but ignores mismatches in the middle.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read one line of words separated by arbitrary whitespace. Print the words in reverse order separated by exactly one space.
task_spec.constraints: At least one word; separators may include repeated spaces or tabs.

cases.defect_explanation: Splitting on a literal space retains empty words and misses tabs.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a line of integers and print the second-largest distinct value.
task_spec.constraints: There are at least two distinct integers. Duplicates are allowed.

cases.defect_explanation: Duplicate maxima occupy both highest positions in the sorted list.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonnegative integer n and print n factorial. Zero factorial equals 1.

cases.correct:
n = int(input())
result = 1
for value in range(1, n + 1):
    result *= value
print(result)
cases.broken:
n = int(input())
result = n
for value in range(1, n):
    result *= value
print(result)
cases.defect_explanation: Initializing the product to n produces 0 for zero factorial.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonempty line of integers. Print the mathematical floor of their arithmetic mean.
task_spec.constraints: The line may contain a single integer.

cases.defect_explanation: Divides by one fewer than the item count and crashes on a singleton.

task_spec.problem_statement: Read a nonempty line of integers and print them in ascending order separated by one space. Do not use sorted().
task_spec.constraints: Do not use sorted(). list.sort() is allowed.

cases.defect_explanation: Produces the right outputs but uses the explicitly prohibited sorted() operation.
